summary: Feasibility-first seeding, safe root canonicalization, primal-search emphasis, live incumbent checkpointing and a diagnostic relaxation ladder were implemented. Matched 180-second and 600-second real-data runs produced no full-model national incumbent. A diagnostic retaining exact counts, purity and opportunity bands became feasible only after both connectivity and state-distance constraints were projected out. Opportunity bounds have not been relaxed.

scope.purity: Unchanged for N, WH and FI
scope.geography: Unchanged; only the existing WA=1200 override remains

implementation.initializer_method: Bounded auxiliary HiGHS MILP with explicit binary state-channel purity selectors and the first nonzero coverage objective. A returned point is stripped to the original variable layout and checked for finite values, integrality and every original model constraint before use.
implementation.fallback: No valid seed means the original solver runs cold. No constraint is relaxed and no pass is skipped.
implementation.checkpoint_method: Atomic JSON containing validated full vectors and model/input/source fingerprints. Save after a validated seed and after each returned engine pass. Root/flow variables are reconstructed and checked when the solver returns only z/y.
implementation.resume_method: Compatible checkpoints provide warm starts for fresh optimization. They are not certificates and do not skip previous objectives or stages.
implementation.progress: stage_progress.json records seed status, deterministic greedy failures, per-pass termination, live incumbent counts, objectives, available dual bounds and node counts, timing, and checkpoint locations.
implementation.feasibility_first: Exact national stages try a validated deterministic greedy point, two seed-only geographic anchor patterns, a heuristic-heavy incumbent-first auxiliary solve, and then ordinary coverage optimization. Seed anchors are released in the production model.
implementation.symmetry: National production models canonicalize each district's single-commodity-flow root to its lowest-index contacted state. This preserves the projected feasible set and composes with the existing nonincreasing-mass slot ordering.
implementation.live_checkpoints: Native HiGHS improving-solution callbacks atomically save each fully reconstructable incumbent before the pass returns or fails.
implementation.diagnostics: Explicit flags can project out SCF connectivity and state-distance rows for labeled feasibility diagnosis. They do not alter normal production runs.
implementation.isolation: Scenario-level hooks are restored on failure. Pre-existing user changes in core planning and staffing files were not edited or committed.

usage.ceiling_case: Use --count-mode cap with a separate fresh output directory.
usage.reuse: Add --resume-checkpoints PREVIOUS_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY/checkpoints. Both the model and provenance must match; changed source hashes reject reuse.
usage.baseline: Use --seed-time-limit 0 to disable the auxiliary initializer. Checkpointing remains enabled.

matched_600_seconds.verdict: No measured speedup; full-model feasibility remains inconclusive

feasibility_first_20260914.conclusion: Do not relax opportunity bounds based on these runs. The next implementation should decompose assignment from geography and contiguity, then repair or cut disconnected or over-distance districts.

limitations: No complete territory plan, realized ZIP assignment, staffing comparison or FEFx audit was produced.
Matched 180-second and 600-second runs establish no initializer speedup on this instance.
Live checkpointing preserves reconstructable incumbents, but no full-model incumbent was found in these benchmarks.
The underlying sequential planner still cannot reconsider national choices after downstream WH/FI failure; cross-channel repair or joint solving is not implemented here.

HiGHS thread count remains process-global. Production Group 2 launches use a fresh process with two threads; live-solver tests use fresh processes to avoid contamination from unrelated suite settings.
followups: Implement a decomposed national feasibility workflow: solve exact count, purity and opportunity assignment first, then impose geography and connectivity through repair or iterative cuts.
Only measure a minimum opportunity-bound violation if the decomposed geography-aware feasibility stage proves the unchanged model infeasible.
After a valid national checkpoint exists, freeze it and solve exact WH=11 and FI=21 before considering joint cross-channel repair.
learned: level0.check_point does not reject NaN by itself; checkpoint and seed boundaries explicitly require finite vectors.
Changing the thread count after a HiGHS pool is initialized can invalidate a solve. The auxiliary and production paths now use the same highspy thread setting.
A full-suite pipeline needs pipefail or a captured runner exit code; filter success alone is not a test pass.
The deterministic real-instance greedy constructor fills only 11 of 14 exact national slots within the unchanged band.
Removing connectivity and geography together makes the exact national assignment easy, while removing either family alone did not yield an incumbent in 60 seconds.
